$comment: Input for sdk/scripts/launch.ts. Values marked TODO_USER must be confirmed by the user before a mainnet run; the launcher refuses --network xlayer while issuance.confirmed is false. Amounts are decimal strings (OKB for *Okb fields, integers otherwise).

cpu.name: Cerebr
cpu.story: Cerebr is an on-chain neural processor. Its transistors are synapses: every NAND minted here is wired into a neuron. Its circuits are neurons and networks, compiled from threshold units into NAND netlists and taped out on X Layer; REF links taped-out neurons into deeper networks, so the brain grows by reuse. eval() is inference: anyone can run any Cerebr circuit on-chain, for free, forever.

issuance.$comment: Confirmed by the project owner on 2026-10-04: 1,000,000 transistors at 0.00001 OKB each. Fixed at createCPU and publicly disclosed. TapeOut lists a processor in its app only if transistorSupply >= 10000 and minted >= 1.

keep.$comment: Transistors minted on top of what the tapeouts burn; they stay in the deployer's wallet. The unit price comes back via withdraw() (the deployer is the creator), so they cost only gas.

pins.$comment: TapeOut is upgradeable. The launcher aborts if any implementation differs from these pins (re-verify on a fork, then update, or pass --allow-impl-change).
